slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman predicts a future where personal AI assistants become as commonplace as household appliances, running partly on local devices and partly in the cloud.

slots.title: Cerebras CEO pushes back on AI doomsday warnings
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman has a message for AI leaders spreading doomsday warnings: Maybe stop talking? At TechCrunch Disrupt, he argued that the industry's focus on AI's risks is drowning out its potential benefits.
